prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a rear-end collision claim. Injury: shoulder injury. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1136; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim received by phone from the insured driver of the rear vehicle. Reports being struck from behind at a traffic signal while stopped. Driver states neck and right shoulder pain at the scene, declined EMS transport. Police report number pending. Vehicle drivable per insured.

Entry 2: Recorded statement taken from claimant. Claimant reports the shoulder pain has worsened overnight and limits lifting and reaching overhead. Claimant has not retained an attorney and states they do not currently plan to. Advised claimant of right to seek medical evaluation and provided a list of in-network urgent care facilities.

Entry 3: Photos of both vehicles received from claimant. Rear bumper damage visible on claimant's vehicle, consistent with reported impact. Other driver's vehicle shows front-end damage. Estimate requested from body shop of claimant's choice. Liability appears clear pending police report review.

Entry 4: Claimant provided medical visit summary indicating evaluation for right shoulder strain and recommendation for physical therapy. Claimant asked how injury claims are evaluated. Explained that bodily injury is assessed separately from property damage and that medical records and treatment itinerary will be needed. Claimant indicated comfort with providing records.

Entry 5: Follow-up call with claimant. Physical therapy sessions have started. Claimant reports improvement in range of motion but ongoing discomfort with overhead activity. Requested itemized medical bills and prior records of any previous shoulder complaints. Claimant agreed to send documents. File remains open pending receipt of records and repair estimate.
